purpose: Standalone final freeze-candidate revision only; no implementation, execution, freeze, or verdict.
scope: Nondimensional classical mixed Model-B(psi)/Model-A(Phi) surrogate. No fundamental MFE/matter, geometry, covariance, Liouville, CFT, BCJ, consciousness, quantum, real-world, or CP11 claim.

model.coercivity: For P'=Phi^2-mean(Phi^2), -eta^2/2<P',L_psi^-1P'> >= -eta^2/4||P'||_2^2 >= -eta^2/4||Phi^2||_2^2; lambda>eta^2 is sufficient, not necessary. For all declared tuples lambda-eta^2>=.49. This is continuum coercivity, distinct from numerical boundedness and nonphysical |field|<=1e6 guard.

numerics.production: N64,dt=.00125; usable only after N128/dt=.000625 calibration, else INCONCLUSIVE with no held-out resolution substitution.
numerics.cadence: t=0,T,every .05; trapezoid time weights .025 endpoints,.05 interior; spatial dx^2
numerics.fft: float64/complex128; dx=2pi/N; ordering [0,...,N/2-1,-N/2,...,-1]; forward N^-2 sum f exp(-ikx), unscaled inverse; dx^2 sum|f|^2=(2pi)^2sum|fhat|^2; K_N=N/2-1; retain max(|kx|,|ky|)<=K_N; zero Nyquist lines; derivative ik and gradient energy k^2 only on retained modes; Hermitian fhat[-k]=conj(fhat[k]).
numerics.products: For every Phi^2,Phi^3,Phi*psi,Phi*(Phi^2-v^2), and coupling product: embed retained N coefficients unchanged in zero 2N spectrum at identical signed modes; inverse unscaled; multiply; forward normalize (2N)^-2; restrict to N retained band; no extra scale. Truncation fraction<=.10; resolved near-cutoff .8K_N<=max(|kx|,|ky|)<=K_N fraction<=.02; both non-increasing 64-to-128 above 1e-12.

rng.initial: seed modulo 2^64; key=(low32(seed),high32(seed) XOR field_tag); counter=(zigzag32(kx),zigzag32(ky),component,stream), zigzag32(k)=2k if k>=0 else -2k-1. Representatives ky>0 or ky=0,kx>0. r0,r1 give u=(r+.5)/2^32; g1=sqrt(-2logu1)cos(2piu2),g2=sqrt(-2logu1)sin(2piu2), z=(g1+ig2)/sqrt2; z_-k=conj(z_k). Modes 0<|k|<=4; zero mode fixed zero; psi/Phi independently tagged and each Parseval-normalized once to RMS .05; modal table and C-order arrays hashed/reused at all grids.

literal_vectors.startup: Compare words bit-for-bit against artifacts/cp10_p0_5_rng_vectors.json; reference must first pass published zero vector, using an independent reference path.

rng.bootstrap: n=16; key=(low32(20260825),high32(20260825) XOR bootstrap_field_tag). For b=0..9999,j=0..15 counter=(uint32(b),uint32(j),0,bootstrap_stream); index[b,j]=r0>>28, exactly uniform because 16 divides 2^32. Store C-order uint8 (10000,16), hash raw bytes/shape/dtype/generation manifest, use exactly it for all paired endpoints/arms; 10000 paired resamples; np.quantile(samples,[.025,.975],method='linear'); recompute ratios inside each replicate.

startup_audits: FFT round-trip<1e-14; Parseval<1e-13; analytic derivative<1e-12; psi zero mode<=1e-12; finite-difference variational mismatch<1e-6
padded-product direct-convolution oracle separately each required product: retained complex128 modal max error<1e-12
eta0 exact psi decay oracle: L2/modal max<=.02, finest temporal<=.02

forced manufactured oracle lambda=v=1,eta=.1,A=B=.1,T=1: psi=.1e^-t cosxcosy,Phi=.1e^-2t sinxsiny; f_psi=5psi+eta Delta(Phi^2),f_Phi=lambda Phi(Phi^2-v^2)-2etaPhi psi; forcing oracle-only; both fields 32-64<=.15,64-128<=.05,finest temporal<=.02

imex.rule: simultaneous first-order IMEX; all nonlinear products use old (psi_n,Phi_n); not energy-stable claim
imex.post: fix psi zero mode; zero Nyquist; Hermitian roundoff correction relative spectral norm<=1e-13 else hard fail.

one_way.rule: Phi uses stored eta0 psi; psi is exact eta0 artifact, reference/hash/parent identical.

arms.energy_arms: eta0,full,and all four sensitivities only; one_way excluded as nonreciprocal.

endpoints.A: q_a=Phi_a^2-spatial_mean(Phi_a^2); A_a=integral psi_a*q_a/max(sqrt(integral psi_a^2*integral q_a^2),1e-12); Delta_A=A_full-A_eta0

hypotheses.errors: epsilon_space,q=error(N64,dtfine;N128,dtfine); epsilon_time,q=error(N128,dtproduction;N128,dtfine); epsilon_production,q=sum. delta_q=max(.01,3epsilon_production,q), separately E_psi,E_Phi,E_feedback_Phi,A. Missing/nonfinite error makes that hypothesis INCONCLUSIVE.
hypotheses.H1: lower paired bootstrap endpoints E_psi,E_Phi each > own delta
hypotheses.H3: lower endpoint Delta_A > delta_A; only numerical surrogate alignment, not physical matter coupling
hypotheses.H4: one_way psi exact eta0 artifact reference/hash/parent ID; mismatch hard provenance failure
hypotheses.pass: H1-H4 plus all applicable numerical/provenance/convergence/artifact/completion gates; related endpoints are not independent discoveries.

validity.convergence: common-band restriction max|k|<=Ncoarse/2-1; full fields/trajectories/final states/endpoints/A/energy errors with floor 1e-12; 32-64<=.15,64-128<=.05,dt/2-dt/4<=.02, nonincreasing. One_way is included in all Stage-C spatial/temporal comparisons required for E_feedback_Phi margin.
validity.energy: variational arms only: D=sum accepted dt[integral|gradmu_psi|^2+integralmu_Phi^2]; R_E=abs(F(T)-F(0)+D)/max(abs(F(T)-F(0)),D,max(1,abs(F0),abs(FT))); median<=1e-3,95%<=1e-2,refinement nonincreasing.

artifacts.atomic: same-directory temp, fsync, atomic replace; no partial final

verdict.failure: completed scientific failure=true,false,reasons; technical interruption=false,false,reasons; missing never PASS

revision_corrections.H2_refinement: one_way is included in C1 spatial and C2 temporal refinement with valid eta0 baseline parent links.

statistical_estimands.unit: finite complete training-seed record; arithmetic mean of corresponding seed-level quantities

per_seed.store_raw: raw numerator and denominator sufficient statistics plus resulting E_psi_s,E_Phi_s,E_feedback_Phi_s,A_full_s,A_eta0_s,Delta_A_s=A_full_s-A_eta0_s
per_seed.denominator_rule: Any required frozen denominator non-finite or <epsilon=1e-12 hard-fails that endpoint; never omit seed.

statistical_estimands.bootstrap: Use same frozen 10000x16 paired uint8 index array for every compared arm/endpoint; each replicate resamples complete seed records and recomputes mean(E_psi_s),mean(E_Phi_s),mean(E_feedback_Phi_s),mean(Delta_A_s). No independently bootstrapped model means or pooled-sum ratio substitution.

H2_margin.definition: epsilon_production_feedback=(epsilon_space_full+epsilon_time_full)+(epsilon_space_one_way+epsilon_time_one_way), using each arm's own refined records; delta_feedback=max(0.01,3*epsilon_production_feedback).
H2_margin.requirement: H2 INCONCLUSIVE unless every term finite/available; pass only lower bootstrap endpoint>delta_feedback.

H3_margin.requirement: H3 INCONCLUSIVE unless every term finite/available.

bootstrap_column_mapping: column j=0..15 maps to held_out[ j ]=1001+j; indices select positions, not literal seeds.
seed_instantiation_correction: All B/C/D calibration records use 1..8; seed 0 prohibited.
